topic: Explaining cinematic framing to his seven-year-old son using Legos
caption:
He asked why the green Lego guy couldn’t just stand in the exact middle of the castle. 

So we spent half an hour talking about "room to breathe" and why the corner of the frame feels more alive. He didn't care about the terms, but he got the geometry instantly. 

Kids are natural visual storytellers before we mess them up with theory. Honestly, his composition is already looking cleaner than mine.
